theme.shipping:
Everything ships from Warrnambool, Victoria. Australia standard $11, express $15, free over $50. International $20. Local pickup is free.

Clay pieces are made after you order, so allow 3–5 business days before they're posted. You'll get tracking by email.

Faulty or damaged? Email sskockzz@gmail.com within 30 days for a replacement, repair or refund. Pieces made just for you can't be returned for change of mind. Your rights under Australian Consumer Law always apply.

items.name: 012 PATINA
items.detail: Mint green and copper, like copper as it ages.
items.description: Serial 012/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. PATINA is named for the green that copper turns as it ages — and it wears both. A mint-green body, a wide black visor pulled low across the eyes, round copper ears, a copper nose, copper talons, and a row of copper plates running down its spine into the tail. A deep teal core and a single cream fang finish it.

items.name: TRAY 002 MIDAS
items.detail: Gold dish, gritted teeth.
items.description: Serial 002/001. One tray, one photo, one owner. Gold clay dish with a sculpted face — bulging eyes, gritted teeth and a tongue lolling over the lip. Rolled flat, walled up by hand and sealed under a UV resin glaze. The photo is this exact tray , not one like it. Roughly palm-sized.

items.name: TRAY 003 OXIDE
items.detail: Deep green, pale blue snout.
items.description: Serial 003/001. One tray, one photo, one owner. Deep green clay dish with a pale blue snout, a matching blue tongue over the lip and dark green studs pressed into the rim. Rolled flat, walled up by hand and sealed under a UV resin glaze. The photo is this exact tray , not one like it. Roughly palm-sized.

items.name: TRAY 005 SULFUR
items.detail: Yellow, scalloped edge, brown studs.
items.description: Serial 005/001. One tray, one photo, one owner. Yellow clay disc with a scalloped edge and four brown studs across the brow, white eyes with amber centres, a black snout, and a mouth of gritted teeth with a soft yellow tongue pushed out over the lip. Rolled flat, walled up by hand and sealed under a UV resin glaze. The photo is this exact tray , not one like it. Roughly palm-sized.

items.name: TRAY 006 PLASMA
items.detail: Magenta, pink fangs.
items.description: Serial 006/001. One tray, one photo, one owner. Deep magenta clay disc with hot pink brows, pale pink eyes on magenta centres, a black snout, two pink fangs and a fat red tongue rolling out over the lip. Rolled flat, walled up by hand and sealed under a UV resin glaze. The photo is this exact tray , not one like it. Roughly palm-sized.

items.name: TRAY 007 FURNACE
items.detail: Flecked red, gold teeth.
items.description: Serial 007/001. One tray, one photo, one owner. Red clay disc, flecked and textured, with two bulging white eyes on red centres, a pair of black nostrils rimmed in red, a row of gritted gold teeth and a long red tongue hanging out over the lip. Rolled flat, walled up by hand and sealed under a UV resin glaze. The photo is this exact tray , not one like it. Roughly palm-sized.

items.name: TRAY 008 ORACLE
items.detail: Lavender with a spiralled third eye.
items.description: Serial 008/001. One tray, one photo, one owner. Lavender clay disc with deep magenta brows and a spiralled third eye set into the forehead, turquoise at its centre. White eyes on violet pupils, two black nostril dots, and a purple tongue pushed out under a wide black mouth. Rolled flat, walled up by hand and sealed under a UV resin glaze. The photo is this exact tray , not one like it. Roughly palm-sized.

items.name: CASE 001 COBALT
items.detail: Teal lighter case, cobalt visor.
items.description: Serial C01/001. One case, one photo, one owner. COBALT is a teal-green clay body under a cobalt blue visor — two heavy curved horns, four teal fangs around a black mouth, and a fat blue tongue rolling out over the lip. Wrapped, shaped and worked around the lighter body by hand in Warrnambool, then sealed under a UV resin glaze. No moulds. No casts. No production line. Built around a full-size lighter — the big ones, not minis.

items.name: CASE 002 ECLIPSE
items.detail: Deep violet, magenta horns.
items.description: Serial C02/001. One case, one photo, one owner. ECLIPSE is a deep violet clay body under a purple visor — two magenta horns, black eyes, and a heavy open mouth rimmed in violet. Wrapped, shaped and worked around the lighter body by hand in Warrnambool, then sealed under a UV resin glaze. No moulds. No casts. No production line. Built around a full-size lighter — the big ones, not minis.

items.name: CASE 003 NARWHAL
items.detail: Ocean blue, one horn, big pout.
items.description: Serial C03/001. One case, one photo, one owner. NARWHAL is a pale ocean-blue clay body under a heavy navy brow, with one blue horn on top, big white eyes glancing sideways, two black nostrils and the biggest pout in the crew. Wrapped, shaped and worked around the lighter body by hand in Warrnambool, then sealed under a UV resin glaze. No moulds. No casts. No production line.

items.name: 001 BLIZZARD
items.detail: Iced blue, gold horns and toes.
items.description: Serial 001/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. BLIZZARD is an upgraded SKOCKSTER — a full step above the standard minis. Iced blue body, pale-blue arms and legs, metallic gold horns and gold toes, finished with a hand-shaped black cap pulled low over the eyes. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts. No production line.

items.name: 002 SCORCH
items.detail: Deep red, hot-pink shift, gold horns.
items.description: Serial 002/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. SCORCH is an upgraded SKOCKSTER — a full step above the standard minis. Deep red body with a hot-pink shift through the arms, metallic gold horns and toes, a black cap tipped over one eye, and its own hand-built red skate deck worked into its arm. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts. No production line.

items.name: 003 VENOM
items.detail: Purple, with its own hand-built deck.
items.description: Serial 003/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. VENOM is an upgraded SKOCKSTER — a full step above the standard minis. Deep purple body with lilac horns and arms, a magenta cap, and its own hand-built purple skate deck with hot-pink wheels that it actually stands on. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts. No production line.

items.name: 004 JADE
items.detail: Glow-green core, bronze-tipped bat wings.
items.description: Serial 004/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. JADE is a hand-sculpted dragon — deep green body, a bright glow-green core, ribbed bat wings tipped in bronze, and bronze horns pushed up through a hand-shaped black visor. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts. No production line.

items.name: 005 SHARD
items.detail: Deep blue dragon, teal wings, bronze horns.
items.description: Serial 005/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. SHARD is a hand-sculpted dragon — deep blue body with teal wing membranes, a teal core, bronze horns and bronze wing tips, finished with a hand-shaped black visor pulled low. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts. No production line.

items.name: 006 TARNISH

items.description: Serial 006/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts. No production line.

items.name: 007 RIPTIDE
items.detail: Turquoise, silver horns and talons.
items.description: Serial 007/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. RIPTIDE is a hand-sculpted dragon — a turquoise body under a deep blue star visor pulled across the eyes, metallic silver horns and talons, a glittering teal core and a single white fang. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts. No production line.

items.name: 008 HAZARD
items.detail: Three greens, deep to lime, one white fang.
items.description: Serial 008/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. HAZARD is a hand-sculpted dragon — three shades of green from deep to lime, a black star visor pulled low across the eyes, a pale mint core and a single white fang. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts. No production line.

items.name: 009 GLACIER
items.detail: Jade-teal with shimmer through the clay.
items.description: Serial 009/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds.

items.name: 010 MIRAGE
items.detail: Four greens, teal tail fin.
items.description: Serial 010/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. MIRAGE is a hand-sculpted dragon in four greens — a lime body, a teal star visor pulled low across the eyes, round bright-green ears and nose, teal arms and a teal tail fin, lime feet studded with green toe beads, a pale mint core and a single cream fang. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts.

items.name: 011 BLOOM
items.detail: Deep violet with magenta spikes.
items.description: Serial 011/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. BLOOM is a hand-sculpted dragon — a deep violet body, a dark indigo star visor pulled low across the eyes, magenta horns, a magenta nose, four magenta toe beads and a magenta spike of a tail, a soft lilac core and a single white fang. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts. No production line.

items.name: 012 PATINA
items.detail: Mint green and copper, like copper as it ages.
items.description: Serial 012/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. PATINA is named for the green that copper turns as it ages — and it wears both. items.name: 013 THRASH
items.detail: Two-tone red. Rides its own board.
items.description: Serial 013/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. THRASH rides its own board. A two-tone red body, a black star visor pulled low across the eyes, silver horns, a silver nose and a single white fang, with raspberry-pink arms and a round red core. It stands on a red deck with four pink wheels, silver studs lined up across its feet. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool.

items.name: 014 ALLOY
items.detail: Four metallic clays on one piece.
items.description: Serial 014/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. ALLOY is the all-metal one — four metallic clays mixed on a single piece. A copper body, a bronze star visor pulled low across the eyes, bronze arms, a round gold core, and gunmetal horns, snout and claws. A single cream fang is the only part that isn't metal. Every part rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds. No casts.

items.name: 015 CRUSH
items.detail: The first one built all in SKOCKZ pink.
items.description: Serial 015/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. CRUSH is the all-pink one — the first SKOCKSTER built entirely in SKOCKZ pink. A hot-pink body, a coral star visor with a pearl shimmer pulled low across the eyes, coral horns, a dusty-pink snout and a single white fang, with salmon-pink arms, a round magenta core and shimmer-coral studs lined up across its feet.

items.detail: Gold SKOCKSTER and matching worry stone.
items.description: Set 01. One SKOCKSTER and the worry stone made to match it, sold together. There is exactly one of this set and this page is it. NUGGET is the gold one. A gold body and round gold core, a slate-grey star visor pulled low across the eyes, a copper nose, two round copper ears, and copper-shimmer arms and claws.

items.name: SET 02 GOBLIN
items.detail: Glitter-olive, curved horns, one white fang. Pale-green marble worry stone.
items.description: Set 02. One SKOCKSTER and the worry stone made to match it, plus 3 stickers you pick, sold together. There is exactly one of this set and this page is it. GOBLIN is the green one. A glitter-olive body, a bright green star visor pulled low across the eyes, two curved green horns, a green nose, a single white fang and a round lime core, with green arms and four green studs lined up across its feet. Three greens on one piece.

items.name: SET 03 GALAH
items.detail: Pink and cheeky. Flip the keychain: SKO on one side, CKZ on the other.
items.description: Set 03. A SKOCKSTER, the worry stone made to match it and a logo keychain, all in the same pinks, plus three stickers you pick, sold together. It's the first set with more than two pieces. There is exactly one of it and this page is it. GALAH is the pink one, named after the pink cockatoo.

items.name: SET 04 BLUEBOTTLE
items.detail: Coiled horns on the stone, like a bluebottle's stingers.
items.description: Set 04. A SKOCKSTER, the worry stone made to match it and a logo keychain, all in the same blues, plus three stickers you pick, sold together. There is exactly one of it and this page is it. BLUEBOTTLE is the blue one, named after the jellyfish that washes up on every Aussie beach come summer. It has a glossy cobalt body, a wide black star visor pulled low across the eyes, a pale-blue nose and a single white fang.

items.name: SET 05 REDBACK
items.detail: Red and gold. Flip the stone over and the whole back is gold.
items.description: Set 05. A SKOCKSTER, the worry stone made to match it and a logo keychain, all in the same reds, plus three stickers you pick, sold together. There is exactly one of it and this page is it. REDBACK is the red one, named after the spider every Aussie kid gets told to check the shed for. It has a glossy red body, a crimson star visor pulled low across the eyes and a gold nose.

items.description: Serial 015/001. There is exactly one of these on Earth and this page is it. CRUSH is the all-pink one — the first SKOCKSTER built entirely in SKOCKZ pink. A hot-pink body, a coral star visor with a pearl shimmer pulled low across the eyes, coral horns, a dusty-pink snout and a single white fang, with salmon-pink arms, a round magenta core and shimmer-coral studs lined up across its feet.

SKOCKZ Socks.
The first run.
blocks.text: One hundred pairs turned up this week, along with one hundred cans, and every can is being numbered by hand. This is the first SKOCKZ product ever manufactured, and it exists because a 17-year-old in Warrnambool put his own money on the table.

Ribbed leg, contrast cuff, heel and toe, with the SKOCKSTER and the SKOCKZ wordmark up the side. Reinforced at the toe and heel, where skate shoes wear through first.

## The can
Every pair comes rolled into a printed collectible tin with a ring-pull lid and a number written on it by hand. The can is half the point: it sits on your shelf long after the socks are in the wash.

blocks.heading: 100 pairs is genuinely not many.
blocks.text: Warrnambool alone could clear that. Get one email the moment the cans go on sale, before the rest of the store sees them. No payment, no commitment.
blocks.note: One email when the cans drop. We never sell your details.

blocks.heading:
Made by a skater,
for the skate community.
blocks.text: SKOCKZ started in a garage in Warrnambool with a simple idea: the gear you rep should feel just as personal as the culture behind it.

blocks.heading: Why I started SKOCKZ
blocks.text:
I'm a Year 12 student and a skater. I started SKOCKZ because the skatepark is where mates are made, tricks are learned, and everything else disappears for a while.

When an injury put me on the sidelines, I felt how isolating it is to be cut off from that. Filming my mates and slowly building back got me through it, and that's the spirit this brand is built on.
blocks.points:
Designed in Warrnambool
Every piece made by hand
Made to shred

items.a: Actually handmade. Every clay SKOCKSTER, keychain and logo piece is rolled, shaped and assembled by hand in Warrnambool. No moulds, no casts. Yours will vary a little from the photos, and that's what makes it one of one.
Yep. Pick your options on the product page. Most clay pieces come in 8 colours, and several have a resin glaze upgrade for a glossy, harder-wearing finish.

items.q: Is it made before or after I order?
items.a: After. Clay pieces are made once your order comes through, so they take a few days. Stickers and anything in stock go out straight away.
A free sticker sheet goes in every single order.

items.q: What's the FREE BONUS KEYCHAIN banner?
items.a: If you see the gold banner on a product page, a second handmade keychain goes in your parcel at no cost. It's a surprise, and it's a real one.

## How long until it turns up?
Stickers and in-stock items | 1–2 business days to make
Clay SKOCKSTERS and keychains | 3–5 business days
Made-to-order tees | 2–3 weeks
Signature Hoodie | ships from November 2026

Then the post: Australia Post is usually 2–6 business days standard, 1–3 express. International is usually 2–4 weeks. You'll get tracking by email the moment it's posted.

items.a: Email sskockzz@gmail.com within 30 days with your order number and a photo. We'll sort a replacement, repair or refund, and cover return postage on faulty items. Your rights under Australian Consumer Law always apply.

items.q: I changed my mind. Can I return it?
items.a: Yes, on most things: send back an unused item in its original condition within 30 days for a refund. Pieces made specifically for you (clay SKOCKSTERS, keychains, custom colours, made-to-order tees) can't be returned for change of mind.
Socks are one size, AU 8–12. For everything else, measure a shirt you already love and compare it with the size guide, or email us and we'll tell you straight.
Visa, Mastercard, American Express and the express wallets at checkout. Checkout runs on Shopify's secure checkout, so SKOCKZ never sees your card details.
